svg.title: Robot Platform Taxonomy
svg.desc: Fifteen MuJoCo robot platforms arranged in a five-column by three-row taxonomy across seven embodiment types. Images are not to scale.
svg.metadata: Large-format hybrid SVG. Vector layout and embedded fonts; 1600-pixel transparent MuJoCo robot renders. Physical canvas: 1189 by 753.37 millimetres.
svg.text: MuJoCo model renders · Images not to scale
